narrative.coaching_note: El cambio más importante es lavarse las manos con agua y jabón después de salir de la zona del paciente, porque el alcohol no elimina las esporas de C. difficile. Usted tocó bed rail A con bare hand a los 0.5 segundos y la contaminación pasó a su mano. Después tocó call button a los 3.4 segundos y phone a los 6.6 segundos, y la contaminación se movió a esos objetos. Se perdió el Momento 5 a los 5.8 segundos y otra vez a los 18.7 segundos con gloved hand después de tocar call button. La próxima vez, lávese las manos antes de ponerse los guantes y no toque phone con los guantes puestos. Al final, bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button y phone quedaron contaminados.
narrative.audit_summary: Source was bed rail A with C. difficile (spores not killed by alcohol rub; soap and water required). Transfers: bed rail A to bare hand at 0.5s, then to call button at 3.4s and phone at 6.6s; bed rail A to gloved hand at 11.1s. Missed Moment 5 at 5.8s (bare hand) and 18.7s (gloved hand). Compliance 0/2 overall and 0/2 for Moment 5; Moments 1, 2, 4 had 0 opportunities. No hygiene events occurred. Glove issues noted in one sequence: donning at 10.9s without prior hygiene involving phone and subsequent gloved contact with phone at 19.3s in healthcare area. Contaminated at end: bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, phone. Disinfect bed rail A, call button, phone with Use an EPA List K sporicidal disinfectant (effective against C. difficile spores); standard disinfectants do not kill spores.
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene with soap and water at 5.8 seconds.
